page.title: Snapshot inspector
page.description: Open a tinyactors snapshot in your browser: each segment's memory, every actor's chart and active states, its record and mailbox, and the traces at the time of capture.

playground.description: The Inspector opens a sample snapshot of 51 actors: orders and the payments they invoked. It shows each segment's memory by pool, an actor's chart with its active states, its record and mailbox, and the trace spans the snapshot kept.
